content: MK reports that in his second apology, written after arrest, torture and exile and so 'less guarded and angrier in tone', Ṣāʾin al-Dīn admits having received a khirqa-yi tabarruk (a blessing cloak) from a great Sufi master before going abroad to study, that is during his residence in Samarkand, and finding on return some fifteen years later that this master's disciples had become antinomian; a later meeting turned into a shouting match. MK does not name the master.
